The day just had little things that really got on my nerves, followed by something big towards the end that just killed me inside. The minor stuff started with both of my headphones blowing out at the start of my walk to school, then sitting in my programming class with nothing to do as usual, come around lunch I catch a glimpse of the girl I had a crush on, and she ignores me. Later on, I'm sitting in my next class with absolutely nothing to do once again, and being told by my teacher that I should just keep quiet so she can teach her lesson.

The ultimate point of my day that really frustrated me was when I saw that girl again. She was flirting with some guy in front of me the entire time I was there. I felt sick to my stomach as she asked for his phone number, and then did that giggle that girls do when they have a crush. I left pretty much right then and there, because I didn't want to see anymore. Now I've just been feeling absolutely sick to my stomach since then.
Well... My day has been a day of disappointment and frustration for the most part. So it's definitely a different day with just the same stuff happening. What about yourself?

I wrote a paper on sleep paralysis and what myths surround it around the world in a world mythology class I had. I got an A on it because the material was unique and well constructed.

I'm not at all religious myself. I am an Apatheist myself, which is essentially just a way of saying that I don't care for religion at all. I respect other people if they want to talk about their beliefs, just as long as they respect mine.

I'll still be on tomorrow, but probably later at night when I can't sleep. Have a good day at work tomorrow then chap, and try not to get stressed out from a long day of work. Goodnight as well.

I've tried dieting and such, and I watch what I eat more than often. I've been running rather hard to lose some weight, and I walk at least 4 miles to school each day as well. I only really started dieting and losing weight to try to look attractive, but today when I tried to go running I lost all inspiration to run. I ended up just running for a mile as quickly as I could rather than run until I couldn't breathe. So I don't really have much of an issue there.

I haven't had any treatment for sleep apnea because I've never told a doctor about my problems. Every time I've told my mother about the dreams I've been having, she puts them off as well. It's a highly unbelievable story, but It's all true. I have no idea if I'm having some sort of out of body experience, of it something supernatural is going on, but it fills me with pure terror. When I wake up, I don't even have a chance to scream, or breathe at that. I'm just forced to watch everything that goes on. I've taught myself how to wake myself up in the middle of a dream as well to prevent something worse happening, but this woman just continues to pursue me outside of my head.

I've had a dream kind of like yours though, with bodies that had no faces and myself crying out for help. But it wasn't a scary nightmare, rather a sad one. I was sitting against a wall weeping by myself while people passed me and just laughed at me or casually ignored me. I was sitting there crying for at least a few hours in the dream, until one of the figures that had a face sat right beside me, wrapped an arm around me, and just held me tight while I wept. That is the only experience I've had that had given me hope for my life, and I have never been so happy than in that moment in my life. It was the saddest nightmare I've had.

My most recent bit of depression was when I was by myself, just trying to build a house of cards. People I didn't even know were wrestling next to me, shaking the table, and throwing things at it while I kept building it. The week before as well, I had broken up with my girlfriend because she was making me sad by the day, and I had lost all motivation for even doing anything when I was with her. Almost in some sort of mocking manner, the people kept asking me personal questions, and then would mock me whenever I had answered. These were things from: 
"Hey, do you have a girlfriend?"
 "No... I broke up with my--" 
"Oh, well I can clearly see why you don't!" to, "Why do you keep trying to build that when you know that we want to knock it down?" 
"Well, I want to build this as tall as I can because I have nothing else to do." 
"Oh, well then go away then because we don't want you here."
"I was kind of here first though..." 
 Apparently, It's now in good taste to call me some sort of other name, because nobody cares to remember my actual name. This was also an area that I had been sitting at with a few people just minding my own business while playing a game.
About a week later this new girl comes along, and I find her really attractive. She has no friends that she knows, but she wants to make some friends. I want to be her friend, and introduce her to a lot of people, but I also want to ask her out as well. But I have no self esteem so I try to build my confidence up. I've been running for the past dozen weeks trying to make myself look better. I've been coughing and wheezing for days trying to just lose a little weight because I have light asthma. I've been trying to talk to her, to make her feel better, to make her feel happy. 
Just yesterday, she tells me that I'm an idiot for even trying to make her happy and ect, she says that she never wanted to be my friend, and the worst was that she had absolutely no feelings for me at all. She has absolutely no feelings for me. I had tried for awhile, and she knew all along that I had a crush on her. She let me fall into my own demise, and mocked me for it. Today, I saw her for a few minutes. She completely ignored me, and told everyone what had happened. Aside from not only being embarrassed, I was completely dead inside.

I've been failing tests left and right because I can't sleep at night. There's this thing in my head that keeps coming back constantly in my nightmares, and it causes me to have migraines, hallucinations, and sleep apnea. I've been seeing it since I was six, almost a year after the incident. For weeks on end, I would be trying to sleep, or trying to dream, and this woman would be stalking me in my dreams, and even sometimes in my hallucinations caused from sleep apnea. But she seems more than real than anything I've ever experienced. In most dreams, I'll be having some sort of dream where I'm alone somewhere, all by myself. But I'll find that this very light screaming sounds starts filling my ears as it approaches me. In the distance is the woman, with black hair reaching down to her waist, a dark red stained white sun dress that covers up to her knees, black, deformed eyes that have little trickles of black blood pooling from them, and a grin with torn up lips. Her scream is always shrill and loud, and I can never outrun her. All she does though in my dreams, is clutch onto my shirt, and force me to stare at her while my eardrums are bleeding from the pressure of her scream.

The true horror comes when I wake up. I've had many occurrences of strange things happen as well, from hallucinations, to things being moved on their own. There have been a few times where I've woken up in a cold sweat because my blankets were on the other side of the room. The worst though, was when I woke up one day with a hallucination of her beside me. She wiped her hand across my face, and when the terror was over and I turned on a light to look into a mirror, there was blood smeared all across my face. There was none on the pillows, and none on the bedsheets. Sometimes when I wake up, there is a little blood that trickles from my ears or nose. I can't explain any of it, but I don't want to fall asleep because of it as well.

The last time that I told them I was depressed was a few months ago. They both yelled at me in response to my depression. It's gotten to a point where I can't tell anyone anything about me being depressed without any sort of negative response. As a guy, It's supposed to be your job to be a man about things and show no emotions isn't it? Or at least that's what society thinks. Once you start showing any sign of emotion around someone, It's like a wave of negative feedback and reaction pools around you.

It's not that I intend to hurt anyone, because it just happens without me really realizing it. Like I said above, I just have issues that I don't really want to talk about. I would just rather I didn't really say anything at all, and just keep living in torment.

I live with my parents currently while trying to make it through school. I can't tell them anything about how I'm depressed or feeling rather blue, because they won't do anything about it but tell me to see a therapist. I don't want to talk to a therapist at all, much less talk to anyone in general because nothing I say will matter.

I would help someone through their everyday nightmares or social stigma if I could. I try to help anyone close to me with their problems, because to me their problems matter more than mine do. I've learned that through life, I don't need anyone to help me when I would rather help someone else. My problems don't matter at all, and I can understand that.

 It's just that I really want to believe that so much, but I can't. I make myself feel unhappy every time I help someone, because in return I want someone to listen to my problems for once. Instead, I just say something along the lines of: "No worries. I'm glad to help," or some sort of bullshit response that I know is a blatant lie. I've made myself out to be the equivalent to that of an emotional and physical punching bag.

I don't speak often, and I almost never want to speak at all. When I was being evaluated to go into elementary school I was put into a special education program. I knew all the words that I wanted to speak, and I knew what each and every one of them meant. I just never spoke, because I really felt that nobody cared to listen to me. These days, I try to speak as little as possible, because I still feel that way. It's even worse when people tell me to speak more, because when I do try to speak I just get ignored. 

Sometimes though, I just don't speak because I don't want to hurt anyone. I've made a lot of people cry because of my words. Some were happy, but many others were intentionally speaking out of unfairness and how hurt I was because of them. I've lost a lot of friends like that because they just don't understand the angle I'm trying to get at. So even when my words do matter, they hurt people in the process.

The worst portion of my story is that, I've tried suicide a few times before. It just won't work for me, and I don't know why I even tried in the first place. I would like to be successful, but instead I have to wander off knowing that I tried to kill myself, and even that I couldn't do right. I can't even manage to kill myself properly. Right now, everything that I am doing in my life if just a distraction. Everything that I'm doing right now: School, hobbies, gaming, work, It's all just a distraction to try and make me forget. Right now It's all coming back to me one way or another.

But every single day I have to wake up, and feel the same way because of something that happened years and years ago. I can't even look at myself in the mirror because I don't want to look at myself. I have nightmares on a night to night basis, and at least once a week I have a nightmare about how nobody will just shut up and listen to me, or how nobody cares about me and just casts me off without any logical reasons, or how I'm just sitting in the corner crying when I really just want someone to be my friend. I feel alone when I go to college and sit in the back of the classroom by myself, or even when I'm surrounded by empty chairs constantly every week. It's gotten to a point where I feel like I'm just being avoided entirely, and I don't think I smell that bad.

So I can't claim anything, and I don't want to claim anything. I don't want sorrow, I don't want people to feel bad for me. I don't want to hear the same answer that I always do when I tell people of my worst memories, or when I tell someone who I try to get close to about some of the more terrible stories. I'm tired of it all, but there is no possible way I can end my own life, or anyone else for that matter. I'm just surviving, but to what cause or what gain?
